title: Discount
description: A discount or offer available to Veterans or service members. The most perishable data on the site: a benefit changes with legislation, a discount changes when a regional manager decides it does. Verification is the product. 200 confirmed offers beat 2,000 scraped ones.

business.description: The company or organization offering it.

reach.description: national works anywhere in the US. state is limited to one jurisdiction. local is a single town or store.

jurisdiction.description: Required when reach is state or local. Omitted for national.

offer.description: The discount itself, as specifically as the source states it. "10 percent off" beats "discount available".

verificationService.description: Third-party ID verification the business uses, if any. Worth surfacing because it tells a Veteran what they will be asked for.

officialUrl.description: The business's own page describing the offer. Required. Never a coupon aggregator: those go stale and are frequently wrong.

expiresAt.description: Only when the source states an end date. Expired offers are hidden at build time.

paidPlacement.description: True if the business paid for this listing. Must be disclosed on the page, and must never affect ordering or inclusion.
